scientific_question: Using identical held-out observations and no shared distances across fitting and test sets, how does the native three-parameter exponential model compare with the frozen cubic/cubic rational candidate and frozen cubic polynomial baseline on NIST Chwirut1?

related_prior_dataset.name: Chwirut2
related_prior_dataset.scope: Chwirut1 observations were not used to design previous candidates or regions, but Chwirut2 was analyzed previously; this is not an independent model-family or laboratory replication test

native_rule.optimizer: scipy.optimize.curve_fit method=lm,maxfev=200000,full_output=true; select lowest finite training RSS
native_rule.singular_rule: Any evaluation point with b2+b3*x=0 returns non-finite prediction; do not replace it with a limit or certified fit
native_rule.failure_rule: Retain every failed start, non-finite RSS, non-finite prediction and failed fold; no post-hoc start, parameter bounds, scaling or fold changes
native_rule.retuning: No model, start, optimizer, parameter constraint, fold or threshold changes after seeing outcomes

known_answer_rule.purpose: Fit all 214 observations only to verify the native exponential equation and optimizer against the NIST known answer; never use this fit as holdout evidence

fold_rule.construction: All repeated observations of a frozen distance remain on the same side; no distance crosses fitting and test sets; every observation is evaluated once in the frozen point order

comparison_rule.join: Match native and rational predictions by fold and frozen point index, x and observed y; repeated x values are retained as separate observations
comparison_rule.rational_metrics: Reuse the frozen rational-candidate fold metrics and snapshot predictions without refitting
comparison_rule.cubic_baseline_metrics: Reuse the frozen cubic-baseline fold metrics without refitting; per-point baseline predictions are not available in the frozen result
comparison_rule.metrics: Recompute native RMSE, MAE and maximum absolute residual from held-out predictions in each fold
comparison_rule.fold_winners: Compare native RMSE with rational and cubic-baseline RMSE separately; preserve wins, losses, ties and failed fits without a single scalar ranking
comparison_rule.pooled_metrics: Compute native and rational RMSE, MAE and maximum absolute residual over all 214 held-out predictions only when every fold succeeds; do not fabricate pooled cubic-baseline metrics
comparison_rule.parameter_stability: Report minimum, median, maximum and range for all three parameters without converting fold variation into a probability distribution or independent physical replication
comparison_rule.bound_separation: Do not transfer rational denominator, ellipsoid, box, residual-bound or continuous-safety claims to the native exponential model

prohibitions: No use of the certified full-data fit as a held-out prediction
No description of Chwirut1 as independent of the Chwirut2 study or native model family
No transfer of rational-model proof regions or residual bounds to the native exponential model
No hiding of optimizer failures, non-finite predictions, fold-level losses or repeated observations
No probability, confidence, physical-endogeneity, absolute-ranking or independent-experiment claim
No post-hoc start, parameter constraint, fold, scaling or model changes after seeing results
